help_text: ℹ️ How does this bot work? 1. The bot monitors cheapestinference.com/pools 24/7 over an encrypted Tor/proxy pipeline. 2. Each tier is partitioned into three 8-hour regional blocks (Asia, Europe, Americas). 3. Live slot availability is updated in real time via dashboard buttons. 4. Use 🔔 My Subscriptions to configure notifications for specific tiers or regions. 5. The moment a slot opens, you receive an instant alert with a direct checkout link! 👨‍💻 Author Contact & Support: Telegram: @grizlizora
